{"metadata":{"description":"a lightweight plugin supports commandcode coding plan in dsh","id":"gh:1349113690","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-commandcode-provider","slug":"CJYLZS/dsh-commandcode-provider","topics":["commandcode","dsh","dsh-plugin","goat"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"a lightweight plugin supports commandcode coding plan in dsh"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-commandcode-provider"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **A lightweight plugin — almost no extra dependencies.** It is plain JavaScript (no build step, no"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" framework), ships only two small files plus a one-file patch, and its sole runtime dependency is `@"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"deepseek-ai/schemastery`, which any dsh plugin already has. Everything else it uses comes from the d"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"sh host itself (`ctx.web`, the settings seam, the credentials seam, the loopback bridge)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"One-click sync of CommandCode subscription-tier models into DeepSeek Harness' `llm-pi-ai` provider c"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"onfiguration, with a "Create / Update" button in the settings page. Existing target providers are on"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ly refreshed (model list updated) — your configured keys and base URLs are preserved. On top of that"},{"id":"p5s4","text":", it can replace dsh's built-in web search (no separate search API key needed) and show your Command"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"Code account usage right in the settings card."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why this plugin"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **dsh's `llm-pi-ai` provider catalog is a static snapshot** that never refreshes itself. CommandCo"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"de's Provider API currently lists 61 models and grows continuously (each with its own context/pricin"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"g/capabilities). Hand-copying them into the provider configuration is impractical and goes stale.
- "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"**The official `/provider/v1/models` endpoint returns only id / name / context_length** — no reasoni"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ng or vision capability info. This plugin additionally parses the complete per-model catalog embedde"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"d in the official GOAT plan page (`reasoning` / `vision` / `caps` / four pricing fields / min plan) "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"and maps capabilities correctly into dsh config.
- **Subscription tiers**: CommandCode has multiple "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"tiers (Go / GOAT / Pro / Max); models accrue by `minPlanName`. The plugin offers a "Subscription" dr"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"opdown; each tier maps to its **own independent model provider**, so tiers never overwrite each othe"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"r.
- **Mixed routing**: CommandCode serves both an OpenAI-compatible (`/chat/completions`) and an An"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"thropic-compatible (`/messages`) endpoint; sending Claude models to the wrong endpoint returns 400. "},{"id":"p7s12","text":"The plugin splits models automatically: Claude models go into `commandcode-<plan>-anthropic` (`api: "},{"id":"p7s13","text":"anthropic-messages`), everything else into `commandcode-<plan>-autosync` (`api: openai-completions`)"},{"id":"p7s14","text":".
- **Web search without a second API key**: stock dsh needs a separate `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` before th"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"e model's `web_search` tool works at all. This plugin serves the same tool from your CommandCode acc"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"ount key, so one subscription covers chat and search — no dsh search key to configure or pay for.
[该"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"ey, so one subscription covers chat and search — no dsh search key to configure or pay for.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### dsh compatibility"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| dsh | Plugin | Settings surface |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| `≥ 0.1.7-alpha.1`, including `0.2.x` | `v0.2.4` | The `v0.2.2` surface, with the dsh peer range le"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ft open so the plugin manager installs it on `0.2` |
| `≥ 0.1.7-alpha.1`, `<0.2.0` | `v0.2.2` | A pa"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ge of its own in Settings (`settings.section`, nav label **CommandCode**), beside the Plugins page's"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" row configuration; writes model reasoning maps and runs auto-sync |
| `≥ 0.1.7-alpha.1`, `<0.2.0` |"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" `v0.2.0` | The Plugins page's row configuration (`plugins.row.config`) only, with no Settings page "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"|
| `≤ 0.1.5-rc.3` | `v0.1.3` | A registered settings section (`settings.register` / `installSection"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"`), listed with the model providers |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`v0.2.4`, `v0.2.2`, and `v0.2.0` all read and write their configuration as live references of their "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"own Cordis `Config`; `v0.2.2` adds the standalone Settings page and writes the reasoning maps by def"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ault, which is what makes the model picker offer thinking levels at all. `v0.1.3` uses the removed `"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"settings.register` / `installSection` API and the retired `settings.plugin.item` slot, so it does no"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"t load on `0.1.7-alpha.1` or later."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`v0.2.4` is the `v0.2.3` code with the install-time limit removed: `v0.2.3` and earlier declared `@d"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"eepseek-ai/dsh-settings >=0.1.7-alpha.1 <0.2.0`, and the plugin manager refuses at install time a pl"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ugin whose declared peers exclude the running dsh, so `0.2.1-rc.1` rejected them with `installation "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"rejected … requirements {"@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings":">=0.1.7-alpha.1 <0.2.0"}` even though the code"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" runs there unchanged. Verified on `0.2.1-rc.1`: the Settings page and the Plugins page's row config"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"uration both render, saving writes the profile patch through the `0.2` settings service, and **Creat"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"e / Update** writes the providers."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The `volatile()` fields need `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 3.18.3 or later, so the dependency floor is "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"`^3.18.4`; an older locked copy fails at load with `volatile is not a function`."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### dsh 兼容性"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| dsh | 插件版本 | 设置界面 |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `≥ 0.1.7-alpha.1`（含 `0.2.x`） | `v0.2.4` | 与 `v0.2.2` 相同的界面；dsh peer 范围保持开放，因此在 `0.2` 上能通过插件管理器安装 |"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"
| `≥ 0.1.7-alpha.1`，`<0.2.0` | `v0.2.2` | 设置页里独立的 **CommandCode** 页（`settings.section`），与插件页的行配置并存；"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"会写入模型思考档位映射并真正执行自动同步 |
| `≥ 0.1.7-alpha.1`，`<0.2.0` | `v0.2.0` | 仅插件页的行配置（`plugins.row.config`），没有设置"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"页 |
| `≤ 0.1.5-rc.3` | `v0.1.3` | 注册式设置节（`settings.register` / `installSection`），与模型供应商并列显示 |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`v0.2.4`、`v0.2.2` 与 `v0.2.0` 都把配置读写为自身 Cordis `Config` 的实时引用；`v0.2.2` 在此之上增加了设置页里的独立页面，并默认写入思考档位映射——"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"正是它让模型选择器里出现思考挡位；`v0.1.3` 用的是已被删除的 `settings.register` / `installSection` 与已退役的 `settings.plugin.ite"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"m`，因此在 `0.1.7-alpha.1` 及之后无法加载。"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"`v0.2.4` 就是 `v0.2.3` 的代码加上解除安装期限制：`v0.2.3` 及更早声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings >=0.1.7-alpha.1 <0.2.0`，"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"而插件管理器会在安装期直接拒绝「声明的 peer 排除当前 dsh」的插件，所以 `0.2.1-rc.1` 会以 `installation rejected … requirements {"@de"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"epseek-ai/dsh-settings":">=0.1.7-alpha.1 <0.2.0"}` 拒绝它们——尽管代码本身在 `0.2` 上无需改动即可运行。已在 `0.2.1-rc.1` 实测："},{"id":"p19s4","text":"设置页与插件页的行配置都能正常渲染，保存通过 `0.2` 的 settings 服务写入 profile patch，**一键创建/更新** 能正常写入供应商。"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`volatile()` 字段需要 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 3.18.3 及以上，因此依赖下限提升到 `^3.18.4`；锁定在更旧版本时会在加载阶段报 `volatil"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e is not a function`。"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"版本不匹配时的表现：浏览器里 `web boot: 1 entry did not activate … pending (waiting for service: settingsScope)`；在"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"新版 dsh 上运行 `v0.1.3` 时，`$DSH_HOME/logs/startup-*.log` 里本包会有 `settings.register is not a function`。"}],"truncated":true}
